meta.orientation: attention[l,i,j] = mean attention from query gene i to key gene j

supplementary_marginal_decomposition_pos.description: log10 attention (head-mean, diagonal excluded) = row effect (query) + column effect (key) - grand mean + interaction. R2 = variance share of the additive part; symmetry of the pair-specific interaction. Added after inspecting the main results.

e_rank_proximity.note: Spearman over gene pairs; pairs are not independent, so no p-values are reported (descriptive).

candidates.definition: ordered pairs (TF, gene): TF = reference TF in G, gene in G, gene != TF, copresence >= 50; positive = non-self reference edge

baseline_notes.degree_product_circular: outdeg(TF) x indeg(target) from the reference restricted to G, including the scored edge: circular, upper-bound reference-bias baseline
baseline_notes.target_indegree_circular: indeg(target) from the reference restricted to G (circular, upper bound)
baseline_notes.degree_product_loo: same with the scored edge removed from both degrees (hub prior without self-leakage)
baseline_notes.target_indegree_loo: indeg(target) with the scored edge removed
baseline_notes.neg_rank_distance: minus mean |rank_TF - rank_gene| over co-present cells

degree_matched_delta_vs_coexpression_pos.description: For every permutation, AUROC(attention) - AUROC(co-expression) on the same rewired edge set; p = share of permutations whose difference is >= the observed difference. Tests whether attention beats co-expression by more than their degree-structure advantage. Added after inspecting the main results.
degree_matched_delta_vs_coexpression_pos.correction: BH across 36 layer x variant tests

marginal_vs_pair_specific_post_hoc.description: Edge recovery by the two parts of log10 head-mean attention: 'additive' = query row effect + key column effect (gene-level hubness only), 'interaction' = pair-specific residual. TF-bootstrap CIs and degree-preserving null as for the raw scores. 'interaction_residualised' = the pair-specific part additionally residualised (OLS) on |r|, r, log mean expression of both genes and mean rank distance: the combined test of signal beyond co-expression, rank proximity and hub degree. Added after inspecting the main results.
marginal_vs_pair_specific_post_hoc.correction: BH across 36 layer x variant tests (interaction)

trrust.orientation: log2 ratio = log2(A[TF,target] / A[target,TF]); A[i,j] = attention from query i to key j. Positive: the TF token (query) attends more to the target token (key) than the target attends to the TF. Negative: the target token (query) attends more to the TF token (key), i.e. the 'target reads from its regulator' reading.

dorothea_abc.orientation: log2 ratio = log2(A[TF,target] / A[target,TF]); A[i,j] = attention from query i to key j. Positive: the TF token (query) attends more to the target token (key) than the target attends to the TF. Negative: the target token (query) attends more to the TF token (key), i.e. the 'target reads from its regulator' reading.

trrust.method: curveball rewiring within candidate set; 1000 permutations; burn-in 20000, thinning 1000 trades; p = (1 + #null >= obs) / (1 + n_perm)

dorothea_abc.method: curveball rewiring within candidate set; 1000 permutations; burn-in 20000, thinning 1000 trades; p = (1 + #null >= obs) / (1 + n_perm)

d_residual_auroc_vs_degree_null_trrust.correction: BH across layers within each variant

attention is approximately symmetric.rule: layer head-mean: Spearman(A_ij,A_ji) >= 0.9 and median relative asymmetry <= 0.1 in all layers -> supported; Spearman < 0.7 or median relative asymmetry > 0.25 in a majority of layers -> not supported; otherwise partially
attention is approximately symmetric.post_hoc: pair-specific interaction part of log10 attention (row and column effects removed): Spearman(I_ij, I_ji) 0.219 to 0.482 across layers; additive row+column part explains 0.24 to 0.72 of log10 attention variance

attention recovers TRRUST edges above co.rule: supported if some (variant, layer) has AUROC above the best co-expression baseline (abs_spearman) with BH-adjusted TF-bootstrap p < 0.05 AND a residualised AUROC whose TF-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0.5, AND the best layer x variant survives the degree-preserving null with max-statistic correction; partially if only one of the first two holds; otherwise not supported
attention recovers TRRUST edges above co.post_hoc: degree-matched: attention exceeds co-expression by more than the degree-preserving null difference in no layer x variant (BH over 36); pair-specific (row/column-removed) attention beats the degree null in sym:L1, sym:L2, sym:L3, sym:L4, sym:L5, sym:L6, qTF:L1, qTF:L5, qTarget:L1, qTarget:L2, qTarget:L3, qTarget:L4, qTarget:L5, qTarget:L6 (BH over 36); covariate residual beats the degree null in qTarget:L3, qTarget:L4, qTarget:L6 (BH over 12 per variant); pair-specific part residualised on co-expression, expression and rank distance beats the degree null in no layer x variant (BH over 36)

attention is explained by expression ran.rule: median over layers of |Spearman(sym attention, mean rank distance)| >= 0.5 -> supported (largely); >= 0.3 -> partially; otherwise not supported
attention is explained by expression ran.post_hoc: closer ranks go with more attention in every layer (Spearman -0.29 to -0.05); linear R2 of log10 attention on rank distance 0.008-0.112; individual heads range -0.45 to 0.40

reference-degree bias inflates recovery.rule: supported if the degree-preserving null AUROC of sym attention has its 95% interval above 0.5 in a majority of layers (part of attention's recovery is reproduced by degree structure alone) AND the circular degree baseline beats every attention layer; partially if either holds or the LOO degree baseline beats every layer; otherwise not supported
reference-degree bias inflates recovery.post_hoc: at the best sym layer (L3) the additive row+column part of log10 attention alone reaches AUROC 0.654 (degree-null mean 0.653); the pair-specific part reaches 0.592 (degree-null mean 0.551); leave-one-out target in-degree alone reaches 0.829

caveats: TRRUST is literature-curated and biased toward well-studied TFs/targets; recovery metrics inherit that bias, which is why the degree baselines and degree-preserving null are reported.
Attention means are computed only over cells where both genes are present (co-presence >= 50 cells); present/absent structure itself is not scored.
Pairs share genes, so pair-level tests (Wilcoxon, Mann-Whitney) are anti-conservative; TF-level bootstrap and permutation p-values are the primary inference.
One tissue compartment (immune), one assay (10x 3' v3), 1,000 cells, one model (Geneformer V2-104M); per-head values use the float32 kit file.
OLS residualisation is linear in the covariates; non-linear dependence on rank distance or expression could remain in the residual.
